name: Unwept Sorrow
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The sorrow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the sorrow has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sorrow makes two Grave Touch attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Unburied Grief.

Actions.name: Grave Touch
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 41 (8d8 + 5) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Unburied Grief
Actions.text: *Charisma Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: The sorrow's Grave Touch lays a grief it refuses to let be buried: a creature struck must make a Charisma saving throw o

lore: It is what remains when a bereavement is refused and left to rot in one place — a spirit of grave-cold that forms where someone died unwept or was mourned past all reason, and it wants only to share its weight until the living carry it too.

generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
